objective: Correct GitHub Actions tag lookup for the Windows desktop preview pre-release. A missing tag must be treated as absent, while an existing tag that points to another commit must remain protected from movement. Preserve the preview build, installer, user manuals, checksums and scientific baseline.

previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: The Windows desktop preview workflow builds the installer and documentation. The first mainline publication attempt failed because the GitHub API 404 response body was interpreted as an existing tag.

previous_knowledge_consumed.source: PR #314 Windows Desktop Preview Build run 45685253239
previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: The corrected Windows preview workflow completed successfully on commit 2b6edd418c79215a3696b385c3e0da3fefd1cf9f.
Format Check and Lint passed. Cumulative Lifecycle Gate failed because the meaningful PR did not include a cycle record; downstream test, smoke, build and audit jobs were skipped.

previous_knowledge_consumed.source: PR #314 CodeQL run 45685252962 and Product Scope Audit run 45685253025
previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: Both checks completed successfully on the PR head.

expected_improvement: Treat a failed GitHub tag lookup as an absent tag without parsing an error response as a tag object.
Retain the guard that refuses to move an existing tag to another commit.
Allow the authorized Windows desktop preview workflow to publish only after its build and verification steps pass.
Record the correction and its evidence in the cumulative lifecycle ledger.

correctness.before: The first mainline preview publication attempt failed at tag lookup despite a successful build.
correctness.after: The corrected lookup passed the PR Windows workflow; mainline pre-release publication has not yet been verified.

reliability.before: A missing tag caused the publication step to stop incorrectly.
reliability.after: The PR Windows build passed; publication on main remains pending.

reproducibility.before: No verified mainline preview release or asset manifest exists.
reproducibility.after: A mainline pre-release must be verified against its tag commit, asset list, checksums and build manifest.

scientific_validity.before: This release-workflow correction does not evaluate astronomical data or model validity.
scientific_validity.after: No scientific-validity claim is made by this change.

measurement.trade_off: This is a release-workflow and process-record correction. It does not change application behavior, scientific data, model artifacts, feature definitions, class order or acceptance criteria.

evidence: PR #314 Windows Desktop Preview Build run 45685253239 completed successfully on commit 2b6edd418c79215a3696b385c3e0da3fefd1cf9f.
Product Scope Audit run 45685253025 completed successfully.
CI run 45685252899 passed Format Check and Lint, then failed the Cumulative Lifecycle Gate because the PR lacked a cycle record. Downstream CI jobs were skipped.
The earlier mainline Windows run 45674732322 failed in the publication step because a GitHub API 404 response was treated as an existing tag.

Scientific Validation run 45685252860 completed its workflow contract, but source-backed DR24/ALeRCE, StarEmbed and immutable historical-reference evidence jobs were skipped. This is not scientific validation.
validation.blocker: Re-run full CI after adding this record, then merge only after required checks pass. The mainline preview publication and its release assets remain unverified.

root_causes: The GitHub tag lookup command captured the 404 response body in stdout. The non-empty error body was incorrectly treated as an existing tag.
The cumulative lifecycle CI gate requires every meaningful PR to add a machine-readable JSON record under configs/process/cycles/.
unresolved: The new lifecycle record must pass the repository validator.
The full CI downstream test, smoke, package build and dependency audit jobs must run and pass.
The mainline preview pre-release must be created and its installer, User Manual, Quick Start, SHA256SUMS and desktop build manifest must be verified.

findings: A GitHub API lookup failure must be distinguished from a successful lookup that returns a tag object.
A tag must not be moved when it already points to a different commit.
A successful Windows preview build does not establish that the pre-release was published.
A successful Scientific Validation workflow contract does not establish source-backed scientific validation when those evidence jobs are skipped.

Pass the full CI test, runtime smoke, package build and dependency audit jobs.
Merge PR #314 only after required checks pass.
Verify the mainline preview release, exact tag target, installer and all required documentation/checksum assets.
Keep CPVS membership discrepancy and all source-backed scientific validation blockers open.

The CPVS candidate/reference membership discrepancy remains an unresolved scientific validation blocker.
No scientific validation claim is made from skipped source-backed jobs.
The Windows desktop package is an evaluation prototype, not a commercial or final product release.
